notes: Phase 58, the 720p entry phase 57 D4 said this field was built for. THREE FACTS, ALL READ RATHER THAN INHERITED. (a) THIS REPO ALSO SHIPS flow_shift: 3.0. scheduler/scheduler_config.json here is byte-identical to the 1.3B's on that field, and 3.0 is the 480p value; upstream's own 720p example passes 5.0 by hand. So schedulerFlowShift below is not a convenience for a config that might disagree — it is the only thing between a 720p render and the wrong sigma schedule, which does not error and does not obviously look wrong. (b) THE ID IS A MODEL AND A GEOMETRY (58 D1). vramMiB is what the node's admission gate is handed, once, before any caller exists — so it is sized at the LARGEST (size, seconds) pair this recipe offers: 1280x720 at 81 frames. An operator who wants this model's cheap corner ships a second recipe id with a shorter list, exactly as 48 D6 says of quantization. (c) THE ARITHMETIC, so the next reader can correct it rather than re-derive it: the transformer is 14B and the repo stores it fp32 (53 GB of the 75 GB download), so nf4 is ~7.7 GB resident against ~28 GB at bfloat16; the UMT5-XXL encoder is 20.8 GB of fp32 in this repo — ~5.2B parameters — so ~2.9 GB at nf4 against ~10.4 GB at bfloat16; the VAE is 0.47 GB and stays float32 (57 D4, unchanged and load-bearing). That is ~11 GB of weights, and the rest of the 24 000 is the 720p temporal latent and the attention activations over 75 600 tokens, which NOBODY HAS MEASURED. It does not fit a 24 GB card at the default reserve, and being refused there rather than dying at 2am is what the gate is for. THE DOWNLOAD IS ~75 GB.
